guarantees: stable classes are not removed or semantically repurposed within v1
themes may change presentation but must not require consumer markup changes
consumer-owned content, protocol semantics, validation, and domain behavior stay outside web-ui
user-controlled values are rendered as text rather than interpreted as HTML
non_contract: DOM element choice unless accessibility semantics require it

version_policy.additive_changes: allowed within 1.x without redefining existing stable semantics
version_policy.patch_numbers: not used as a compatibility signal; contract/v1 is the stable lane

validation_scope.css_effectiveness: browser smoke/screenshot evidence; not a full CSS cascade proof
validation_scope.fixture_role: proof-of-presence, not a prescriptive layout template
